protocol.item: round-4 20.P1.1 -- test the shift-robust score process on the closed-loop distribution
protocol.inputs: frozen results/window_anchor_v1_study attempt records only; no re-simulation
protocol.unit: one attempt (the locked spec resets confidence state per attempt)
protocol.stream: the attempt's own window_audit scores, in window order
protocol.warm_pool: results/data/cal_<regime>.npy, exactly as the deployed calibrator used
protocol.endpoint_1: fraction of attempts whose deployed radius already dominates every closed-loop score it met (rho_tot = 0 suffices)
protocol.endpoint_2: the smallest rho_tot on the grid that restores domination for each attempt that needs one, and the implied effective delta delta*exp(-rho_tot/beta)
protocol.endpoint_3: the same, split by regime and by injected tracking bound
protocol.retention: every attempt retained, including those needing no budget and those the grid cannot fix
protocol.not_claimed: this prices an OBSERVED shift on one simulated study; it does not establish a shift budget that transfers to deployment, and rho_tot chosen after seeing the stream is a diagnostic, not a certificate
